acceptanceCriteria: A documented, repeatable benchmark setup on WSL2 (Go 1.27.2, clone on ext4, idle-check before each run recording load average and CPU governor) is retained with host spec.
V1-2205 and V1-2300 measurements are run there at a named sha with enough repetitions for a stable median, and their tickets are updated with the evidence.
Results record the host as WSL2 so no gate compares them against another platform's baseline.
body: Perf qualification is blocked on a quiet host: this Mac runs lanes at load 25-60 and CI runners are shared. Pending: V1-2205 (V1-0887 50 ms / V1-1512 Tasks latency), V1-2300 (V1-2285 index wall time -20%), and per-host calibration (V1-2347). The owner offered WSL2 Ubuntu on a quiet Windows machine over SSH (2026-10-22). The clone must live on the WSL ext4 filesystem (not /mnt/c); WSL2 numbers are their own baseline and are never compared directly with macOS or native Windows numbers; no native Windows tests may run during a benchmark.
title: Stand up WSL2 Ubuntu on the owner's Windows host as the quiet benchmark host and run the pending quiet-host measurements
